verses.26: And the superscription of his accusation was written over, THE KING OF THE JEWS.
verses.27: And with him they crucify two thieves; the one on his right hand, and the other on his left.
verses.28: And the scripture was fulfilled, which saith, And he was numbered with the transgressors.

verses.31: Likewise also the chief priests mocking said among themselves with the scribes, He saved others; himself he cannot save.
verses.33: And when the sixth hour was come, there was darkness over the whole land until the ninth hour.
verses.35: And some of them that stood by, when they heard it, said, Behold, he calleth Elias.
verses.36: And one ran and filled a spunge full of vinegar, and put it on a reed, and gave him to drink, saying, Let alone; let us see whether Elias will come to take him down.
verses.38: And the veil of the temple was rent in twain from the top to the bottom.
verses.39: And when the centurion, which stood over against him, saw that he so cried out, and gave up the ghost, he said, Truly this man was the Son of God.
